movers.text: The Steelers benched QB Aaron Rodgers on Tuesday night; Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. Denver and Rodgers will be inactive (coach's decision), per ESPN.
QB Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol after reporting symptoms following the 27-24 loss to the Jets; Jim Harbaugh said he must clear every step to face New England.
QB Sam Darnold (quadriceps/rib), who missed Weeks 9-10 before the bye, is set to start at San Francisco if Wednesday's practice goes well; Drew Lock started both games.
QB Carson Beck (back spasms) is questionable after missing the 34-7 loss at Kansas City, when Josh Johnson started; Gardner Minshew is on IR after UCL surgery.
Edge Micah Parsons (ACL) has been cleared to make his season debut Wednesday at the Rams, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

LAC.text: QB Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol after reporting symptoms following the 27-24 loss to the Jets; Jim Harbaugh said he must clear every step to face New England.
LB Daiyan Henley (knee) and CB Tarheeb Still missed Week 11; Harbaugh said both are day to day in treatment this week.

SEA.text: QB Sam Darnold (quadriceps/rib), who missed Weeks 9-10 before the bye, is set to start at San Francisco if Wednesday's practice goes well; Drew Lock started both games.
OL: G Quenton Nelson is doubtful and LT Charles Cross questionable on ESPN's injury list for Sunday at San Francisco.

ARI.text: QB Carson Beck (back spasms) is questionable after missing the 34-7 loss at Kansas City, when Josh Johnson started; Gardner Minshew is on IR after UCL surgery.
Secondary: DBs Will Johnson and Andrew Wingard are on IR. The Cardinals also fired DC Nick Rallis on Monday; Teryl Austin is interim DC.

GB.text: Edge Micah Parsons (ACL) has been cleared to make his season debut Wednesday at the Rams, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
Guards Kevin Zeitler (triceps) and Sean Rhyan (ankle), OT Travis Glover and RB Josh Jacobs (finger) are all questionable for tonight on the Packers' final report.

NE.text: Mike Vrabel said Tommy DeVito stays QB1 while Drake Maye (fractured right fibula, Week 10) is out; Maye remains on the 53-man roster.
G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) was designated to return from IR on Monday.
WR A.J. Brown (hamstring) wasn't on the field for Monday's practice session and is listed doubtful by ESPN.

LA.text: OL: G Steve Avila and C Coleman Shelton (hamstrings) are ruled out on the Rams' final report for tonight vs. Green Bay; TE Terrance Ferguson needs season-ending surgery.
WR Puka Nacua (MCL surgery) is out 4-5 months and WR Davante Adams (hamstring, IR) is more likely back mid-December.
DT Kobie Turner (groin, designated to return from IR) practiced fully Sunday and Monday; RB Kyren Williams (toe) went from limited to full.

IND.text: The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Anthony Richardson Sr. makes his first start of the season vs. the Giants.
Both starting OTs (Bernhard Raimann, Jalen Travis) and CBs Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward missed Week 11; all four are questionable for the Giants.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring), out Weeks 9-11, is questionable; Kevin O'Connell has said Kirk Cousins stays the starter. WR Jordan Addison (thumb) is not expected to play.

SF.text: RT Colton McKivitz fractured and dislocated his ankle vs. Minnesota and is likely done for the season; CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) is still hurting, per Kyle Shanahan.

PHI.text: Joe Milton starts again; he started Weeks 9 and 11 after Tanner McKee (now limited, ribs) started Weeks 7-8. Jalen Hurts is on IR.
CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) returned to limited work in Tuesday's walkthrough; edge Arnold Ebiketie (oblique) did not practice. TE Dallas Goedert was full.

DET.text: Secondary: S Chuck Clark (hamstring) was limited Tuesday and CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. is questionable; CB D.J. Reed, out the last three games, practiced fully.
Front seven: DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) and LB Jack Campbell are on IR, rookie DT Skyler Gill-Howard needs season-ending knee surgery, and edge DJ Wonnum is questionable.

CHI.text: Secondary: S Elijah Hicks (concussion) is ruled out for Thanksgiving at Detroit and CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder), who missed Week 11, is questionable.

KC.text: OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) remained out of practice Tuesday and RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) was limited; both missed Week 11. TE Noah Gray was full.
G Trey Smith (concussion), who missed Week 11, was a full participant again in Tuesday's practice.

BUF.text: CB Christian Benford (groin) was limited in Tuesday's walkthrough and is questionable; TE Dalton Kincaid and G O'Cyrus Torrence were limited, RT Spencer Brown full.

DAL.text: TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is doubtful after sitting out again Tuesday and G Tyler Booker (ankle) is out for Thanksgiving vs. Philadelphia.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring, IR, designated to return) was a full participant on Monday's estimated report.

NO.text: OL: OT Asim Richards is doubtful and OT Taliese Fuaga and C Erik McCoy questionable after all three sat the last two games.
TE Juwan Johnson (hamstring) is still being evaluated after leaving the 21-13 loss at Chicago, per Kellen Moore.

BAL.text: Jacoby Brissett has started Weeks 10-11; Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) has a possible Week 16 return.
CB Marlon Humphrey was a healthy scratch at Carolina; the Ravens are noncommittal on him for Houston. DT Nnamdi Madubuike is questionable.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR, surgery not foreseen per Jeff Hafley; Kyle McCord started Weeks 10-11 and goes again vs. the Jets.

LV.text: Rookie Fernando Mendoza makes his third start since Kirk Cousins was traded to Minnesota; he was sacked five times in the Week 11 loss at Denver.
TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad), who missed Week 11 at Denver, is questionable for Sunday night at Cleveland.

PIT.text: The Steelers benched QB Aaron Rodgers on Tuesday night; Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. Denver and Rodgers will be inactive (coach's decision), per ESPN.
LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) is listed doubtful after Mike McCarthy said it will be tough for him to play Friday; LB Nick Herbig (hip) was limited Tuesday.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR) was a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough and is expected back vs. Denver.

HOU.text: LB Azeez Al-Shaair is on IR after groin surgery and DE Chris Braswell (knee, Nov. 19) is out for the season; DE Danielle Hunter is questionable.

JAX.text: OL: OT Walker Little (knee) left the Giants loss and C Robert Hainsey is questionable; RT Anton Harrison is on IR. RB Bhayshul Tuten aggravated his ankle.

NYG.text: CB Greg Newsome II (high ankle sprain) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday after John Harbaugh said he will miss multiple weeks.

TEN.text: OL: Peter Skoronski, Jackson Slater and Fernando Carmona are all on IR; RB Tyjae Spears (knee) also went on IR.

TB.text: Secondary: CB Benjamin Morrison (hamstring) and CB Jacob Parrish (back) had MRIs Monday; S Antoine Winfield Jr. is questionable.

DEN.text: RB J.K. Dobbins is suspended for Friday's game at Pittsburgh for conduct detrimental to the team, Sean Payton announced Tuesday.
